About Us

The Team Behind GMW Electrician

GMW Electrician is run by Gary. We are electrical and air conditioning contractors based in Norwich, and customers come back to us for everything from a light switch to a full rewire.

We take on domestic, commercial and industrial electrical work across Norfolk, along with air conditioning, smart home systems, media walls and cinema rooms. Whatever the size of the job, the aim is the same: do it properly and keep you in the picture.

GaryOwner, GMW Electrician
